changelog:
Initial release of juejin-geo-draft-generator (掘金 AI-GEO 草稿发布助手):

- Generates developer-focused technical article drafts for the 掘金平台 from AI-GEO content assets.
- Strictly reads assets from the local `/input/` directory and outputs drafts and metadata files in `/output/juejin/`.
- Adapts content to developer perspectives with background, practical examples, reflections, and structured summaries.
- Assists with filling in titles, summaries, tags, and provides a pre-publish checklist; requires manual user review before publishing.
- Enforces strong privacy and security measures (no user data or cookies saved/exported, no automatic publishing or interaction features).
summary: Assist in generating and filling Juejin-style technical article drafts from AI-GEO content for manual review and publication in the Juejin creator center.
